why: Leaves this session's persistence-notice registration attached at teardown. The callback closes over the session's HUD, which is destroyed on every campaign/versus reboot, so a notice arriving later would call `showToast` on a torn-down HUD. Killed by loop.test.ts's 'unregisters on teardown, so a notice cannot reach a dead HUD', which counts the live registrations and then fires a notice after disposal. 1 of 366. Widened by issue #317's session-host work: the repeated-session route now fails here too, at 'leaves exactly one settings-notice subscriber'. 2 of 397; the pre-existing case ('unregisters on teardown, so a notice cannot reach a dead HUD') still fails, so this is coverage added, not moved -- checked by naming the failing set on both sides, not by renumbering.
